direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Uncrop the right inspector heading and opening-story band so no text is clipped at the stage edge; reduce stage padding by 8px instead.
Enlarge SVG option, event and job labels to at least 11px and raise silverDim contrast on the dark grid.
Link each evidence row to its 120 or 80 bar with bidirectional highlight and a visible focus ring.
Keep Route health pre-flight, with nonce and identity checks, as a separate labelled group from Investigation source evidence; do not merge status lines.
Add a clear empty-state marker in the investigation panel so untracked, not-yet-run analysis cannot be mistaken for a completed result.
Enlarge the three option chips under the jobs and align their time and cost in tabular columns.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the selected substitute option, show exact phrase, typed count and disabled Accept until match; add aria-describedby for the match state.
Truncate or wrap the guide instruction within 52px so it never clips under the stage border.
Make the selected option card distinct by marker and text, not border color alone.
Preserve the untracked-until-approval label on each proposed task and keep Decline plus Approve as the only actions; do not add tracking controls before approval.
Add a visible end-of-list affordance that does not overlap the internal scrollbar and keep t3 fully readable at 1366x768.
Enlarge the 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 route labels and offset them from the neon route line.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2 with dashed outline plus PREVIEW text, distinct from the solid red stopped state used after application.
Keep the invalidation consequence adjacent to the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar status centre.
Dim the unavailable Start a fresh scenario control and state why it is unavailable rather than presenting it as plain text.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2 with cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; ensure no feasible neon route passes through it.
Keep route-health pre-flight separate from the investigation task and show that investigation has not yet run on the changed snapshot.
Align the constrained option note under Split available capacity so it does not collide with neighbouring chips.
Preserve prior-acceptance-invalidated status in the DecisionBar while the typed consent form is empty, with Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches.
Mark Split available capacity as infeasible with icon, pattern and reason text, and remove it from keyboard selection order.
Enlarge the revised-plan summary in the Human decision panel and separate plan identifier from the required phrase.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks visibly grouped apart from the approved revised plan and the proposed replacement tasks awaiting approval.
Prevent the proposed list scrollbar from obscuring task status; add right padding and a clear bottom fade with End of proposal marker.
Make the prior-work disclosure a 36px keyboard target with expanded state announced to assistive technology.
Sequence Verify ledger, passphrase entry and Export independent checkpoint as numbered gated steps, disabling each next control until the prior step completes.
Clarify the passphrase rule in one line near the field and add an error summary target without adding narration elsewhere.
Align 70, 35h and 48h metrics on one baseline with tabular numerals and equal column widths.
Replace the active-step styling on Recovery story complete with a sealed completion marker and keep Proof selected in the phase map.
Add check markers plus text for each retained-evidence item so completion is not conveyed by color alone.
Keep the sealed status sentence in the DecisionBar centre and leave no primary action competing with Back.
